##### Listing Details

This online business is a highly profitable, veterinarian-invented pet medical care brand with a proven track record of over 350,000+ units sold. Operating primarily through a streamlined Amazon FBA model (US) with additional channels via Chewy and wholesale, the brand has established itself in the pet care niche. Unlike generic private-label competitors, this brand commands unparalleled credibility, having been trusted and utilized in university teaching hospitals nationwide. This is a highly defensible asset with institutional validation, organic top-3 keyword rankings, and clear infrastructure built for immediate scaling.

The founding team, preparing for retirement, highlights that the business is not being sold due to a lack of opportunity but rather as a lifestyle choice. Approximately 95% of the business is driven through Amazon, with the top selling product boasting over 5,400 reviews, averaging out to 4.3 stars and an Amazon's Choice badge. The business's participation in Amazon's Strategic Account Services offers potential continued support and strategic guidance post-sale, making this a compelling opportunity for a buyer looking to take over a well-established, loved, and market-leading brand in the pet healthcare industry.

Disclaimers:

Inventory is not normally included in the list price, further details can be provided to Unlockers.

The legal entity section of the Seller Central account is currently locked to the USA meaning a buyer would need a legal entity in this country for a quick transfer. Alternatively, it is possible to unlock this section, and doing so could delay the migration process. If the legal entity section cannot be unlocked, the buyer reserves the right to reverse the deal.

This business has a loan associated with it. The seller intends to pay off the loan as part of the sale.

The seller notes that they have had "Some suspensions due to sizing issues, etc. We dispute with Amazon using pictures, etc., and the listings are reinstated."

[Semrush's Authority Score](https://www.semrush.com/blog/semrush-authority-score-explained/) is a compound metric used for measuring a domain's overall quality and SEO performance. It's based on a series of metrics that prove trustworthiness and authority.


Unlike other similar SEO industry metrics, [the Semrush Authority Score is the least manipulable](https://www.semrush.com/blog/new-authority-score-manipulation-resistant-metric/) because in addition to link quality (3 levels deep) it also takes into account organic traffic data and any spam signals that might be present.


The Semrush Domain Rank is a website's position in a list of every single website in Semrush's database, sorted by organic traffic. At present there are over 39 million websites in list. For reference, Empire Flippers ranks as the 96,500th most trafficked website in Semrush's database.

##### Opportunities

- Expanding outreach to build a larger recurring B2B customer base
- Increasing Facebook, TikTok, Google, affiliate, influencer, and content creator marketing beyond Amazon
- Launching and scaling developed products.
- Expanding into additional international Amazon marketplaces
- Developing underutilized products within the existing catalog

##### Risks

- An increase in Amazon ad pricing could make the ads unprofitable.
- Amazon can suspend or cancel your FBA account due to a breach of its terms of service (ToS).
- An increase in Paid Traffic pricing could make the ads unprofitable.
- Supplier increasing prices
- Amazon can suspend or cancel your account due to a breach of its terms of service (ToS).

##### Work & Skills Required

- Boxing and shipping customer orders
- Managing accounting and bookkeeping
- Managing Amazon advertising campaigns
- Resolving Amazon-related issues collaboratively

##### Seller Support Includes

The seller is willing to offer 90 days of dedicated transition support, including up to 14 hours of video or phone strategy sessions and responsive email guidance. Support includes training on Amazon Seller Central, introductions to trusted suppliers, historical PPC, Chewy, and wholesale strategies, operational troubleshooting, ordering guidance, growth planning, and final knowledge transfer; it does not include ongoing daily task execution such as customer service or live PPC campaign management.

##### Reason for Sale

The seller would like to retire after having built this business to where it is today.
